"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A strong and secure Israel is vital to the United States because the United States and Israel share overarching strategic interests and the common values of democracy, equality, tolerance, and pluralism.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States will oppose any effort to delegitimize Israel, including at the United Nations or through the Boycott, Divestment, and Sanctions Movement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States will continue to work toward a two-state solution of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict negotiated directly by the parties.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A two-state solution will guarantee Israel's future as a secure and democratic Jewish state with recognized borders.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A two-state solution will provide the Palestinians with independence, sovereignty, and dignity.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Jerusalem should remain the capital of Israel, an undivided city accessible to people of all faiths, as a matter for final status negotiations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Israelis deserve security, recognition, and a normal life free from terror and incitement.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Palestinians should be free to govern themselves in their own viable state, in peace and dignity.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
